rules: Use only the fresh canonical train1421 V8 prefix cache.
Treat the early [6,7,7,9,10] fixed schedule named in the proposed STOP-C0 protocol as the primary baseline.
Use the zero-observation-cost clairvoyant bound as an optimistic upper bound. If it fails a final-context gate, added Target observations cannot rescue that gate.
Do not train a stopper and do not make new Target calls when the optimistic bound fails.
Report the existing depth-10 costed oracle only as a distinct quality-heavy operating-point control, not as evidence that the early-schedule gate passes.
